info.title: News Sentiment Analyzer
info.description: Production-quality News Sentiment Analyzer API: collect headlines, classify sentiment with multi-model inference, explain predictions with token attributions, and track thematic sentiment trends over time.

get.description: Check API service availability, runtime environment, DB connectivity, and models.

post.summary: Classify sentiment for one or more headlines
post.description: Classify sentiment polarity (score in [-1.0, 1.0]) and class probabilities (positive, neutral, negative) across one or more news headlines using selected models. Supports batch evaluation up to 50 items.

422.description: Validation error on input texts or limits

post.summary: Generate token attributions explaining a prediction score
post.description: Compute signed feature attribution weights in [-1.0, 1.0] explaining a specific model's sentiment prediction score on a headline. Supported methods include 'occlusion' (leave-one-out), 'integrated_gradients' (Captum path-integral), and 'shap' (partition explainer). Caches results in SQLite if an article_id is supplied.

422.description: Validation error on headline text limits

post.description: Register a new thematic news topic and query string for automated ingestion.
